rules.desc: Floors->height overshoots Soviet blocks: pipeline uses lv*3.2+1.2/0.6 (5->17.2, 9->29.4, 16->51.8). Real panel blocks ~15/27/46 m, and the panel facade (3.0 m ground + 2.85 m floors) then draws 10 storeys on a 9-storey block.
rules.match: buildings with extra.floors>=5 (1453 tagged in Buiucani; 9-storey x174, 10 x63, 11 x46, 5 x258)
rules.change: h = floors*2.85 + 0.8  (5->15.1, 9->26.5, 10->29.3, 16->46.4); keep style 1 (panel) for floors 5-16 outside the old centre

rules.desc: Residential towers randomly styled 'glass': pipeline gives style 2 to 50% of h>=40. In Buiucani 27 of 31 glass buildings are 13-16-storey Soviet/1990s residential blocks (e.g. Alba Iulia 15-16 floors @47.0424,28.7603 and 47.0406,28.7743).
rules.match: style==2 && extra.floors>=12 && no extra.name in {Crown Plaza, Infinity Tower, Royal Tower}

rules.desc: Industrial sheds get random 13-31 m heights (pipeline 'else' branch by area). 1234 untagged buildings inside OSM landuse=industrial in Buiucani, 353 of them h>=13 (13x158, 16x62, 19x55, 28x64, 31x12). Satellite (Mesager/Columna/Petricani industrial zone, 3 views, ~10 buildings) shows 1-2 storey halls.
rules.match: no extra.floors && centroid inside OSM landuse=industrial && h>=13 && style!=4

rules.desc: Small untagged buildings in old-centre fringe and private-house areas are too tall: A<400 m2 and no levels -> random 6.5/7.5/10/13 m (810 sector buildings h>=10). Satellite near Str. Sfatul Tarii/Bucuresti shows 1-2 storey pitched-roof houses tagged 13-16.
rules.match: no extra.floors && A<400 && h in {10,13} && style 0

rules.desc: Two-way streets stored at 3.9 m: OSM lanes=1 on two-way streets -> lanes*3.3+0.6=3.9 m, narrower than one car lane each way. In sector: Serghei Lazo, Sfatul Tarii, Mitropolit Dosoftei, Anatol Corobceanu, Toma Ciorba, Alexei Sciusev, Nicolae Iorga (~4.9 km). Verified only on Sciusev (real ~9-11 m); others under tree cover.

Oneway carriageways with untagged lanes get DEFW*0.75 (trunk 11.2, primary 10.5) -> round(w/3.3)=3 lanes; OSM tags most Buiucani oneway trunk/primary carriageways lanes=2 (Balcani ring 1.7 km, Calea Trusenilor 1.9 km, Calea Iesilor NW split 0.7 km).
